policy.release_qualified_support: AmigaOS/m68k becomes supported only after its exact toolchain is pinned, a FreeBASIC executable is linked, and that executable passes on an independent documented runner.
policy.generated_c_only: Generated C establishes neither an ABI-compatible executable nor runtime behaviour.

runner.name: Vamos
runner.limitation: The pinned libamiga exit path returns Vamos status 255 after the asserted marker; process termination is not validated.
